results.detail: accountBound: CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT or CI_HAS_HETZNER_ACCOUNT unset; real-account cloudflared tunnel info + tunnelConnectorUp capture not exercised. Set CI_HAS_CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT=true AND CI_HAS_HETZNER_ACCOUNT=true (with HCLOUD_TOKEN and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN in the environment via security-secrets-management) to run the real-account path.
